{{Top|leg}}
An '''overcharge valve''' was a straightforward modification that enabled a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] user to release the entire ammunition reserve in one powerful, destructive shot. This attachment could be added to any blaster or energy [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] that would logically benefit from such an enhancement. The [["One-Shot" Overcharge Valve]], by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]], was such a type of overcharge valve.<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>
